articles.title: Lockheed Martin to Increase Patriot Missile Production Under Pentagon Deal
articles.mainIdea: Lockheed Martin to Increase Patriot Missile Production Under Pentagon Deal
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Lockheed Martin to Increase Patriot Missile Production Under Pentagon Deal. The defense contractor committed to surging its Patriot missile output to roughly 2,000 interceptors a year in response to demand from Pentagon officials gearing up for conflicts on multiple fronts.
